-- [[ GLEB (ROBLOX_EGOR) ULTRA RUN ON SPOT ]]
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
local ToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")

ScreenGui.Parent = game.CoreGui
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

Frame.Name = "GlebFinalMenu"
Frame.Parent = ScreenGui
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 110)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.5, -55)
Frame.Active = true
Frame.Draggable = true

Title.Parent = Frame
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
Title.Text = "ROBLOX_EGOR RUN" -- Твой новый ник!
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255)

ToggleBtn.Parent = Frame
ToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 45)
ToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.45, 0)
ToggleBtn.Text = "SPOT RUN: OFF"
ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 0)

local active = false
local lockedPos = nil

ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    active = not active
    local char = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    local animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    
    if active then
        ToggleBtn.Text = "SPOT RUN: ON"
        ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 0)
        lockedPos = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        if animate then animate.Disabled = true end -- Глеб, отключаем мешающий скрипт
    else
        ToggleBtn.Text = "SPOT RUN: OFF"
        ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 0)
        if animate then animate.Disabled = false end -- Включаем обратно
        local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            for _, track in pairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do track:Stop() end
        end
    end
end)

game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if active then
        local char = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local animate = char and char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        
        if hum and root and lockedPos and animate then
            if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                -- Глеб, это чтобы не двигаться вперед:
                root.CFrame = lockedPos
                root.Velocity = Vector3.zero
                
                -- Ищем твою анимацию бега
                local runAnimId = animate.run.RunAnim.AnimationId
                local track = nil
                
                for _, t in pairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                    if t.Animation.AnimationId == runAnimId then track = t break end
                end
                
                if not track then
                    local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
                    anim.AnimationId = runAnimId
                    track = hum:LoadAnimation(anim)
                    track:Play()
                end
                
                track:AdjustSpeed(8) -- Скорость ног на максимум!
            else
                -- Если стоим, обновляем позицию, чтобы можно было сдвинуться без чита
                lockedPos = root.CFrame
                for _, t in pairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do t:Stop() end
            end
        end
    end
end)

	button.Parent = frame
	button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 50)
	button.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0, posY)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255)
	button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	button.TextScaled = true
	button.Text = text
	button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	return button
end
